title: AAC Active Package Set 1
description: Defines the canonical AAC Active Package Set schema and its serialized data contract.

FormatVersion.description: Version of the persisted or exchanged document format.

RecordRevision.description: Storage-provider record revision used for optimistic concurrency and change tracking.

LastTransactionId.description: Stable identifier of the last transaction associated with this AAC active package set.

Selections.description: Lists the selections associated with this AAC active package set.

ApplicationScopeId.description: Stable identifier of the application scope associated with this selection.

ComponentId.description: Stable identifier of the AAC component associated with this selection.

ComponentVersion.description: Version of the AAC component associated with this selection.

Sha256.description: Specifies the sha256 for this selection.

SelectedAt.description: Specifies the selected at for this selection.

PreviousSha256.description: Specifies the previous sha256 for this selection.

PreviousVersion.description: Version of the previous associated with this selection.
